title: First- and Second-Extension Credits on Kestrel Auto Finance Deferrals
content:
A first-extension credit on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts is a flat dollar credit subtracted from the deferral fee. It follows the deferrals already granted on the contract, counted as its deferral entries on the loan history.

## Decision table

| Earlier deferral entries on the contract | Credit |
|---|---|
| none | first-extension deferral credit: 2.00 |
| exactly one | second-extension deferral credit: 1.00 |
| two or more | none |

## Reading the table

- The count is of deferrals granted before the one being requested; the deferral being granted is not one of them.
- Every deferral entry on the contract counts, however long ago it was granted.
- Hypothetical: a contract with deferral entries from 2023 and 2025 has two earlier deferrals and takes no credit; a contract with none takes 2.00.
